title: Reading a Boolean circuit
statement: Given a natural number $n$, a fuel bound, and a Boolean list, the circuit reader returns either no result or a circuit on $n$ variables together with the unconsumed suffix of the list. With zero fuel it returns no result; with positive fuel it reads a literal from a false bit, a polarity bit, and a unary index encoding when the decoded index is less than $n$, or reads a node from a true bit, a gate label, and a valid encoding of its children.
